description: This file defines custom exception classes for a FastAPI project, including HTTP and WebSocket exceptions, validation errors, and related error handling infrastructure.

classes.name: HTTPException
classes.description: An exception class for HTTP errors in FastAPI, extending Starlette's HTTPException, allowing raising errors with status code, detail, and optional headers.

classes.name: WebSocketException
classes.description: An exception class for WebSocket errors, extending Starlette's WebSocketException, with a code and optional reason.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: Base class for validation errors, storing error details and endpoint context information.

classes.name: RequestValidationError
classes.description: Specific validation error class for request validation issues, extending ValidationException.

classes.name: WebSocketRequestValidationError
classes.description: Validation error class for WebSocket request issues, extending ValidationException.

classes.name: ResponseValidationError
classes.description: Validation error class for response validation issues, extending ValidationException.

classes.name: PydanticV1NotSupportedError
classes.description: Error indicating that Pydantic v1 models are no longer supported.

classes.name: FastAPIError
classes.description: Generic exception class for FastAPI-specific errors.

classes.name: DependencyScopeError
classes.description: Error indicating invalid scope dependencies within FastAPI.

classes.name: FastAPIDeprecationWarning
classes.description: Custom warning class for deprecation notices in FastAPI.
